encryption.title: Where should encryption keys live?
encryption.intro: Every credential people save on a connection (API tokens, OAuth tokens) is encrypted. Choose who holds the master key. You can change this later under Platform → Encryption keys.
encryption.builtinNote: The OS keeps the master key in the cluster, never in a backup. Recovery: without a recovery key, losing the cluster's key means reconnecting the connections; a recovery key avoids that, but whoever holds it can open them.
encryption.providerNote: Recovery: a recovery key opens the credentials even if the KMS key or its access is lost — or choose none and reconnect in that case.
encryption.skipNote: Skipping keeps the built-in key; Monitoring warns until the recovery choice is made.
